description_en: Modifies the connection address of a PolarDB cluster. The address can be a primary address, default cluster address, custom cluster address, or private domain name
description_zh: 修改PolarDB集群的连接地址，包括主地址、默认集群地址、自定义集群地址和私有域名
kebab_example: aliyun polardb modify-db-endpoint-address --db-cluster-id pc-000000000000000 --net-type Public --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBEndpointAddress

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the details of all clusters in your account, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the connection address.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98205.html operation to query the ID of a connection address
parameters.help_zh:
连接地址ID。

您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98205.html查询连接地址ID
parameters.name: db_endpoint_id

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the connection address. Valid values:

Public: public network

Private: private network

<props="china">

Inner: classic network

</props>

<props="china">

Only PolarDB for MySQL clusters support the classic network type.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
连接地址的网络类型，取值范围如下： 

Public：公网
Private：私网
<props="china">- Inner：经典网络</props>

<props="china">仅PolarDB MySQL版集群支持经典网络类型。</props>
parameters.name: net_type

parameters.help_en:
The new connection string prefix. The prefix must meet the following requirements:

It can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

It must start with a letter and end with a letter or a digit.

It must be 6 to 30 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
新的连接地址前缀，需满足如下条件：
由小写字母、数字、中划线（-）组成。
以字母开头，以数字或字母结尾。
长度为6~30个字符
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the private domain name. The prefix must meet the following requirements:

It can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

It must start with a letter and end with a letter or a digit.

It must be 6 to 30 characters in length.

You can bind a private domain name to each private endpoint of a PolarDB cluster. This domain name is effective only in the specified VPC within the current region. The private domain name is managed by PrivateZone and is mapped to the built-in private endpoint of the cluster through a CNAME record. This feature incurs a small fee. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/71338.html.

This parameter is valid only when NetType is set to Private
parameters.help_zh:
私有域名前缀。需满足如下条件：
由小写字母、数字、中划线（-）组成。
以字母开头，以数字或字母结尾。
长度为6~30个字符。

对于PolarDB的每一个私网地址，均可以绑定一个用户的私有域名，该域名仅在当前地域内指定的VPC中生效。私有域名实际上是通过PrivateZone管理的，通过CNAME映射到PolarDB自带的私网地址上，该功能PrivateZone会收取少量费用，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/71338.html。
仅NetType=Private时该参数有意义
parameters.name: private_zone_address_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The private zone name.

This parameter is valid only when NetType is set to Private
parameters.help_zh:
私有域名Zone名称。

仅NetType=Private时该参数有意义
parameters.name: private_zone_name

parameters.help_en:
The port number. The valid range is 3000 to 5999.

This parameter is supported only for PolarDB for MySQL clusters. If you do not specify this parameter, the port defaults to 3306
parameters.help_zh:
端口号，取值范围为3000～5999。
仅PolarDB MySQL版集群支持该参数，若该参数留空，则默认端口号为3306
parameters.name: port
